properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: InsecureSkipVerify is set to true in TLS configurations used for sending emails in tests, which disables certificate verification and allows potential MITM attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT tokens signed using RSA algorithms (RS256/PS256) in both v1 and v2 provider files. These are classical signature algorithms that are vulnerable to quantum attacks and need migration to ML-DSA or SLH-DSA.

properties.value: Multiple locations use == operator for comparing strings instead of constant-time comparison functions, creating potential timing attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The application parses RSA private keys for JWT signing operations, which uses classical RSA encryption vulnerable to quantum attacks. This should be migrated to post-quantum signatures like ML-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA signature usage found in Apple authentication provider files. ECDSA is a quantum-vulnerable algorithm that should be migrated to post-quantum alternatives such as ML-DSA or SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT tokens are signed using ECDSA with ES256 algorithm. While ECDSA is more secure than RSA, it is still vulnerable to Shor's algorithm and needs to be migrated to post-quantum signatures like ML-DSA.
